kinds.name: Guwain
kinds.summary: The “Brine Dwarves.” Averaging four feet and well over 250 pounds. Most live along the coast; a few hold out in mountaintop villages where the air is thin and cold.

features.name: Stout
features.description: Higher Endurance and Power maximums, lower Grace maximum.

features.name: Prodigious Lungs
features.description: Can hold their breath for hours, and are unbothered by the thin air of high altitudes.

features.name: Beard Nets
features.description: Guwain beards grow in thick, tangled messes. Most Guwain braid theirs, often with tie-offs and a meshed pattern that lets them carry goods inside.

kinds.name: Isek
kinds.summary: The so-called “Free Elves.” Brash and adventure-seeking by nature, this nigh-immortal Kind rarely sees old age. Young Isek chase rebellion and are possessed of an irresistible wanderlust.

features.name: Nigh Immortal
features.description: Isek don’t age past their prime, though with their inveterate adventure-seeking and simple lack of self-care, few live to see old age.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: Higher Power and Grace maximums, lower Demeanor maximum.

features.name: Restless
features.description: Ill-suited to sedentary life. Isek have easier access to military, guild, and caravan Traits.

kinds.name: Tatot, Goblinoid
kinds.summary: The “High Orcs.” A polyphenic Kind: every Tatot is born either orcoid or goblinoid. Goblinoids are small, with plentiful mana.

features.name: Goblinoid
features.description: Higher Memory and Logic maximums, access to magic Traits, and +6 MP.

features.name: Merchant Clans
features.description: Easier access to trading guild and merchant clan Traits.

kinds.name: Tatot, Orcoid
kinds.summary: The “High Orcs.” A polyphenic Kind: every Tatot is born either orcoid or goblinoid. Orcoids are larger and stronger, have no mana, and are largely immune to sunsickness.

features.name: Orcoid
features.description: Higher Power and Endurance maximums. No mana, and largely immune to sunsickness.

features.name: Merchant Clans
features.description: Easier access to trading guild and merchant clan Traits.

origins.name: Dreft
origins.summary: Born and raised in the Kingdom of Dreft, whether in Port Herminst, a coastal town, a farming village or the mountains.

origins.name: Kingdom of Karsef
origins.summary: You grew up in the Kingdom of Karsef, across the Corsine Pass from Dreft, and an old rival of it.

origins.name: Kingdom of Sorellion
origins.summary: You grew up in the Kingdom of Sorellion, one of Dreft’s neighbors on Isekai.

origins.name: The Drovus Empire
origins.summary: You grew up in the Drovus Empire, which has spent the last decade swallowing its neighbors, the Sunrise Princedoms among them.

professions.name: Alchemist
professions.summary: Studies the properties of substances and brews potions to unlock them, with more ambition than safety.

professions.name: Caravaneer
professions.summary: An itinerant merchant trader, always moving between ports, cities, and kingdoms.

professions.name: Dreft Local Militia
professions.summary: Called up from a town or village to defend it from bandits and monsters when the crown’s soldiers are far away.

professions.name: Dreft Mercenary
professions.summary: Fights for whoever pays, guarding caravans, settling feuds and filling out noble armies in the succession crisis.

professions.name: Gate Hand
professions.summary: Works the switch port for Tetra Frontiers Co.: hauling, translating, and generally being useful.

professions.name: Guild Hunter
professions.summary: Hunts monsters for pay and glory. Hunting guilds keep posts and track the monster bounties put up by the kingdom or locals.

professions.name: Hedge Witch
professions.summary: Practices magic outside the licensed system of Dreft and its neighboring kingdoms. Working far from the scrutiny of cities and trading posts, these mages are a mixed bag.

professions.name: Licensed Mage
professions.summary: Trained in the licensed colleges of magic in Dreft or one of its neighboring kingdoms, these mages practice officially sanctioned, and supposedly safe, magic.

professions.name: Royal Guard
professions.summary: Sworn to the crown of one of Isekai’s kingdoms, and as adept with a blade as with courtly manners.

professions.name: Sailor
professions.summary: Works the merchant ships and fishing boats out of Glintl and Port Herminst, and knows every tavern on the coast.

pasts.name: Countryside Upbringing
pasts.summary: Grew up in the sleepy Dreftian countryside, where the year turns on the harvest and every hedge has a story.

pasts.name: Expelled from the Mage Schools
pasts.summary: Studied at one of Port Herminst’s licensed schools of magic until something went wrong, and left with half an education and a secret.

pasts.name: Glintl Docks
pasts.summary: Grew up on the busy docks of Glintl, the other great trading port on Dreft’s western coast.

pasts.name: Karsef Border Veteran
pasts.summary: Served in the skirmishes over the Corsine Pass, where Dreft and Karsef have been testing each other for generations.

pasts.name: Merchant Dynasty
pasts.summary: Child of a trade family grown rich off the switch port, and resented for it.

pasts.name: Monster-Raided Village
pasts.summary: Survived a monster raid on the home village, and learned to watch the tree line ever since.

pasts.name: Noble Household
pasts.summary: Born or raised in service to a noble house, just in time for the succession crisis.

pasts.name: Palace Servant
pasts.summary: Served in the royal palace at Port Herminst, close enough to the crown to hear things, and there when the queen died under unusual circumstances.

pasts.name: Raised in the Caravan Town
pasts.summary: Grew up in the shadow of Castle Tetra, among foreigners and the people who profit from them.

pasts.name: Returned from the Settled Systems
pasts.summary: Left Dreft for the settled systems and came back changed, like everyone who comes back.

pasts.name: Sunrise Refugee
pasts.summary: Fled the Sunrise Princedoms when Drovus finished absorbing them.
